source.description:
## PROBLEM
Installed 3.21.6 packed validation ran `sp run service-knowledge-sync --model commandcode/deepseek-v4-flash --prompt ...`, but launch failed immediately: specialist has no model configured. Adding the same model through isolated XDG user.json makes `sp view` and run accept it. The CLI model override is applied after or omitted from the missing-model validation gate.

## REPRO
Use a specialist whose package config has execution.model null. Invoke `sp run <name> --model <valid-provider/model> --prompt audit --no-beads`. Expected override satisfies validation; actual missing-model refusal.

## SCOPE
Generic run CLI precedence/validation and tests. Do not change service-knowledge role defaults.

## VALIDATION
Foreground/background, prompt/bead, configured/null base model, invalid override, and observability model attribution.
